bms_g_4148_20000022.name: bms_soc_restore_status_4148
bms_g_4148_20000022.description: Probably a restore or validity status byte of the BMS_4148 and BMS_4139 SOC state. bms_state_restore_or_init writes it at boot and bms_soc_update_from_voltage reads it. It is reached through a base pointer, so its exact field, size and values are not resolved in this packet.

bms_g_4130_200000fd.name: bms_soc_4130_hi_current_timer
bms_g_4130_200000fd.description: High-current timer of the BMS_4130 SOC estimator. bms_soc_estimate_4130 adds the elapsed step to it while the current is above its threshold (uVar18 above 600 in that function) and it stops at 40 (0x28). Probably the 4130 counterpart of the 4168 timer bms_soc_hi_current_timer. Range 0 to 40.

bms_g_4130_200000fe.name: bms_soc_4130_word_hi
bms_g_4130_200000fe.description: High byte of the 16-bit word at 0x20000112 (a copy of the state block word at +0x1F4). bms_soc_estimate_4130 writes it on every run, probably so that a byte-oriented consumer (a telemetry or protocol frame) can read the word. The consumer is not in this packet.

bms_g_4130_200000ff.name: bms_soc_4130_word_lo
bms_g_4130_200000ff.description: Low byte of the 16-bit word at 0x20000112 (a copy of the state block word at +0x1F4). Written together with bms_soc_4130_word_hi by bms_soc_estimate_4130. The consumer is not in this packet.

bms_g_4130_20000100.name: bms_soc_4130_seed_done
bms_g_4130_20000100.description: Flag of the BMS_4130 SOC estimator that gates one branch of bms_soc_estimate_4130. It is set to 1 and cleared to 0 in that function. Probably 1 once the rest-time OCV seed has been applied. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4130_20000101.name: bms_soc_4130_clamp_latch
bms_g_4130_20000101.description: Latch of the BMS_4130 SOC estimator. bms_soc_estimate_4130 sets it to 1 when a voltage-based comparison passes and clears it to 0 on the other path, which keeps the clamp from being applied again until it is cleared. Probably meaning clamp applied. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4130_20000103.name: bms_rem_4130_sample_cnt
bms_g_4130_20000103.description: Ten-step counter of bms_remaining_time_4130. It is incremented every tick and wraps to 0 after 9, so every tenth tick the current sample at 0x20000116 is latched into 0x20000114. Range 0 to 9.

bms_g_4130_20000104.name: bms_rem_4130_hold_flag
bms_g_4130_20000104.description: Hold flag of bms_remaining_time_4130, written on its two paths. Probably 1 while the time-to-go estimate is held at its previous value. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4130_20000105.name: bms_rem_4130_pending_hv
bms_g_4130_20000105.description: One-shot flag of bms_remaining_time_4130. It is set to 1 and then cleared by the check of the pack-voltage word at state +0x118 against 0x1503, so it marks a high-voltage condition that is still pending (probably). Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4130_20000106.name: bms_rem_4130_switch_hold
bms_g_4130_20000106.description: Switch-over flag of bms_remaining_time_4130. While it is 0 and the hold counter 0x20000118 is below the estimate 0x2000011A, the output at state +0x128 is taken on the local path (probably). Set to 1 and cleared to 0 in the function. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4130_2000010a.name: bms_soc_4130_sample_cnt
bms_g_4130_2000010a.description: Ten-step counter of bms_soc_estimate_4130. It wraps after 9 steps, and the voltage-error sample is also taken when the step value exceeds 100. Each sample pushes the accumulator 0x2000010C into the eight-entry ring at 0x20000DAC and resets this counter to 0.

bms_g_4130_2000010c.name: bms_soc_4130_err_acc
bms_g_4130_2000010c.description: Accumulator of voltage-error terms in bms_soc_estimate_4130. Each tick it adds the signed term for that tick (sVar2 = this word plus the step). After each ten-step sample it is divided by the count and stored as one entry of the ring at 0x20000DAC, then cleared to 0. Probably in millivolts. Signed.

bms_g_4130_2000010e.name: bms_soc_4130_track_a
bms_g_4130_2000010e.description: Dead-band accumulator of bms_soc_estimate_4130 (same pattern as bms_tracking_filter_step). It adds a signed term each tick. At 129 or more the associated SOC integrator moves up by one and 128 is subtracted; at -129 or less it moves down and 128 is added. Between those limits it is left alone. Signed.

bms_g_4130_20000110.name: bms_soc_4130_track_b
bms_g_4130_20000110.description: Second dead-band accumulator of bms_soc_estimate_4130, fed by the same term as bms_soc_4130_track_a and with the same +/-129 and 128 pattern, for its own integrator. Signed.

bms_g_4130_20000112.name: bms_soc_4130_state_1f4_copy
bms_g_4130_20000112.description: Copy of the 16-bit state block word at +0x1F4, taken by bms_soc_estimate_4130 on each run. Its two bytes are copied to 0x200000FE and 0x200000FF. The measured quantity and unit are not identified in this packet.

bms_g_4130_20000114.name: bms_rem_4130_latched_current
bms_g_4130_20000114.description: Latched current of bms_remaining_time_4130. It is copied from 0x20000116 every ten ticks (the ten-step counter at 0x20000103) and is used in the time-to-go calculation. Signed; it is the current taken from the s16 at state +0x11A (probably in tenths of an ampere, unit not confirmed).

bms_g_4130_20000116.name: bms_rem_4130_sample
bms_g_4130_20000116.description: Current sample of bms_remaining_time_4130: a copy of the s16 at state +0x11A, taken while the gate bit at state +0x124 is set (and the value is in its usable range, probably 1 to 1399). It is latched into 0x20000114 every ten ticks. Signed.

bms_g_4130_20000118.name: bms_rem_4130_hold_cnt
bms_g_4130_20000118.description: Hold counter of bms_remaining_time_4130. It is set to 0 when the hold ends and is compared with the estimate at 0x2000011A in the switch-over rule that decides what reaches the output at state +0x128. Probably a counter of ticks in the hold state.

bms_g_4130_2000011a.name: bms_rem_4130_estimate
bms_g_4130_2000011a.description: Time-to-go estimate of bms_remaining_time_4130, in minutes. It is computed from the commanded percent (state +0x104), the hour integrators and the reference current, and 30 minutes are added when the percent is above 95. It decays by one unit every 600 ticks through 0x2000011C. Whether it reaches the state block at +0x128 depends on the hold rule (0x20000118 and 0x20000106).

bms_g_4130_2000011c.name: bms_rem_4130_decay_tick
bms_g_4130_2000011c.description: Tick counter for the decay of the time-to-go estimate in bms_remaining_time_4130. It wraps at 600 ticks, and at each wrap while the estimate 0x2000011A is nonzero the estimate is lowered by one minute (probably).

bms_g_4130_2000011e.name: bms_rem_4130_pct_shadow
bms_g_4130_2000011e.description: Shadow of the commanded SOC percent (u16 at state +0x104, 0 to 100) kept by bms_remaining_time_4130. It is refreshed whenever the command changes, so the estimator can see a change in the target.

bms_g_4130_20000120.name: bms_soc_4130_timer_27000
bms_g_4130_20000120.description: Periodic timer of bms_soc_estimate_4130. It counts while a condition on the state block holds and wraps after 27000 counts (the test is at 26999). Probably a slow supervisory action; the action itself is not in this packet.

bms_g_4130_20000124.name: bms_soc_4130_rest_ticks
bms_g_4130_20000124.description: Rest-time counter of bms_soc_estimate_4130. It counts ticks while the rest branch is taken (bit 6 of the status byte at 0x200001C8). After 1200 ticks (0x4AF) the integrators are seeded from the OCV SOC and bit 4 of the flag byte is set. It is cleared while the estimator is active (probably).

bms_g_4130_20000128.name: bms_soc_4130_bins
bms_g_4130_20000128.description: Seven 32-bit accumulators of bms_soc_estimate_4130 at stride 4 (0x20000128 to 0x20000143). Each is added to in one branch and cleared to 0 in the other. Element 0 (0x128) accumulates current times time (uVar18 minus iVar13); elements 1 to 5 (0x12C to 0x13C) each accumulate the per-tick term iVar9; element 6 (0x140) is compared with 3000 and 36000 (probably a time threshold). The purpose of each bin is probably a charge or time bin, not resolved in this packet.

bms_g_4139_2000014a.name: bms_rem_4139_sample_cnt
bms_g_4139_2000014a.description: Ten-step counter of bms_remaining_time_4139, the BMS_4139 counterpart of bms_rem_4130_sample_cnt. It wraps after 9 and triggers the latch of the current sample at 0x20000156. Range 0 to 9.

bms_g_4139_2000014b.name: bms_rem_4139_hold_flag
bms_g_4139_2000014b.description: Hold flag of bms_remaining_time_4139, the BMS_4139 counterpart of bms_rem_4130_hold_flag. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4139_2000014c.name: bms_rem_4139_pending_hv
bms_g_4139_2000014c.description: One-shot pending flag of bms_remaining_time_4139, the counterpart of bms_rem_4130_pending_hv. Cleared when the pack-voltage word at state +0x118 is above 0x1503. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4139_2000014d.name: bms_rem_4139_switch_hold
bms_g_4139_2000014d.description: Switch-over flag of bms_remaining_time_4139, the counterpart of bms_rem_4130_switch_hold. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4148_20000153.name: bms_soc_4148_main_153
bms_g_4148_20000153.description: Byte of the BMS_4148 and BMS_4139 SOC state read and written by bms_soc_main_step through a base pointer. The exact field and its meaning are not resolved in this packet; probably a status or counter byte.

bms_g_4139_20000156.name: bms_rem_4139_latched_current
bms_g_4139_20000156.description: Latched current of bms_remaining_time_4139, copied from the s16 at state +0x11A every ten ticks and then passed on to 0x20000158. The BMS_4139 counterpart of bms_rem_4130_latched_current. Signed.

bms_g_4148_20000156.name: bms_soc_4148_volt_156
bms_g_4148_20000156.description: Field of the BMS_4148 and BMS_4139 SOC state read and written by bms_soc_update_from_voltage through a base pointer. Probably a byte-sized status or percent value. Its exact field, size and meaning are not resolved in this packet.

bms_g_4139_20000158.name: bms_rem_4139_ref_current
bms_g_4139_20000158.description: Reference current of bms_remaining_time_4139. It is copied from 0x20000156 and used as the divisor when the energy gap is converted to minutes (through FUN_08001110). The BMS_4139 counterpart of bms_rem_4168_ref_current.

bms_g_4139_2000015a.name: bms_rem_4139_hold_cnt
bms_g_4139_2000015a.description: Hold counter of bms_remaining_time_4139, the counterpart of bms_rem_4130_hold_cnt. Compared with the estimate at 0x2000015C in the switch-over rule.

bms_g_4139_2000015c.name: bms_rem_4139_estimate
bms_g_4139_2000015c.description: Time-to-go estimate of bms_remaining_time_4139, in minutes, computed the same way as bms_rem_4130_estimate. Decays by one minute every 600 ticks through 0x2000015E.

bms_g_4139_2000015e.name: bms_rem_4139_decay_tick
bms_g_4139_2000015e.description: Decay tick counter of bms_remaining_time_4139. It wraps at 600 ticks and lowers the estimate at 0x2000015C by one minute at each wrap while that estimate is nonzero (probably).

bms_g_4139_20000160.name: bms_rem_4139_pct_shadow
bms_g_4139_20000160.description: Shadow of the commanded SOC percent (state +0x104, 0 to 100) kept by bms_remaining_time_4139. Refreshed when the command changes.

bms_g_4148_2000018c.name: bms_soc_4148_main_18c
bms_g_4148_2000018c.description: Byte of the BMS_4148 and BMS_4139 SOC state read and written by bms_soc_main_step through a base pointer. Field, size and meaning are not resolved in this packet.

bms_g_4148_20000190.name: bms_soc_4148_main_190
bms_g_4148_20000190.description: Byte of the BMS_4148 and BMS_4139 SOC state read and written by bms_soc_main_step through a base pointer. Field, size and meaning are not resolved in this packet.

bms_g_4168_200001dc.name: bms_soc_ocv_pct
bms_g_4168_200001dc.description: SOC percent (0 to 100) from the 11-point OCV table. bms_soc_from_ocv_table stores its result here and sets 100 on the saturated path. bms_soc_main_step tests it for the 50 to 97 percent band, and bms_soc_tick_update uses it as the resync target after the 1800-tick timer.

bms_g_4168_200001dd.name: bms_soc_vring_idx
bms_g_4168_200001dd.description: Write index of the eight-entry voltage ring at 0x20000F00. bms_voltage_error_track stores each new 16-bit sample at this index and then advances it (probably wrapping at 8). Range 0 to 7 in use.

bms_g_4168_200001de.name: bms_soc_hi_current_timer
bms_g_4168_200001de.description: High-current timer of the 4168 SOC estimator. bms_voltage_error_track adds the elapsed step to it while the current at state +0x11A is above its threshold, and it stops at 40 (0x28). It selects the voltage weighting in that function (probably). Range 0 to 40.

bms_g_4168_200001df.name: bms_soc_near_full_latch
bms_g_4168_200001df.description: Latch in bms_soc_main_step for the near-full condition. It is set to 1 once the voltage condition has held (the 16-bit value at +8 of the input record at or above about 4101 mV for 1200 ticks, probably) and is cleared to 0 in the branch that resets it. While set, the profile logic treats the pack as full (probably). Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001e0.name: bms_soc_low_current_latch
bms_g_4168_200001e0.description: Latch in bms_soc_main_step for low current. It is set to 1 and cleared to 0 in that function, and it is cleared when the current in the input record (+2) is below 10 while the latch is set. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001e1.name: bms_soc_latch_cnt_a
bms_g_4168_200001e1.description: Byte accumulator in bms_soc_main_step. It adds the step each time its condition holds and is cleared to 0 on the other path. The threshold that uses it is not in this packet; probably one of the timers of the latch logic. Wraps as a byte.

bms_g_4168_200001e2.name: bms_soc_latch_cnt_b
bms_g_4168_200001e2.description: Second byte accumulator in bms_soc_main_step, with the same form as bms_soc_latch_cnt_a. Its threshold is not in this packet. Wraps as a byte.

bms_g_4168_200001e3.name: bms_soc_hold_flag_a
bms_g_4168_200001e3.description: Flag of bms_soc_main_step. It is set to 1 and cleared to 0 in its branches, and the test on it, together with bms_soc_hold_flag_b and bms_soc_hold_flag_c, decides a state change when all three are 0. Meaning not resolved; probably a hold or in-window state. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001e4.name: bms_soc_hold_flag_b
bms_g_4168_200001e4.description: Flag of bms_soc_main_step, set to 1 and cleared to 0 in its branches, and tested together with bms_soc_hold_flag_a and bms_soc_hold_flag_c. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001e5.name: bms_soc_hold_flag_c
bms_g_4168_200001e5.description: Flag of bms_soc_main_step, set to 1 and cleared to 0 in its branches, and tested together with bms_soc_hold_flag_a and bms_soc_hold_flag_b. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001e6.name: bms_soc_band_pct
bms_g_4168_200001e6.description: Copy of the estimate byte at state +0x11E, taken by bms_soc_update_from_voltage. The 50 to 97 percent band logic in that function compares it with 49 and 51 and holds the SOC inside the band, so it is used as a band reference (probably). Percent, 0 to 100.

bms_g_4168_200001e9.name: bms_meas_primed
bms_g_4168_200001e9.description: First-call flag of bms_meas_interp_filter_dispatch. It is 0 until the first call, which sets it to 1 and skips the low-pass filter for that call. Later calls filter the measured voltage at 0x200001F0. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001ea.name: bms_rem_4168_cnt_a
bms_g_4168_200001ea.description: Twenty-step counter of bms_remaining_time_4168. It is incremented each tick and wraps to 0 after 19, so it samples every 20 ticks. Range 0 to 19.

bms_g_4168_200001eb.name: bms_rem_4168_hold_flag
bms_g_4168_200001eb.description: Hold flag of bms_remaining_time_4168, the 4168 counterpart of bms_rem_4130_hold_flag. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001ec.name: bms_rem_4168_update_flag
bms_g_4168_200001ec.description: Flag of bms_remaining_time_4168, set to 1 and cleared to 0 on its paths. Probably marks that the estimate was updated in this cycle. Meaning not resolved. Only 0 or 1.

bms_g_4168_200001ed.name: bms_rem_4168_pending_hv
bms_g_4168_200001ed.description: One-shot pending flag of bms_remaining_time_4168, the counterpart of bms_rem_4130_pending_hv. Cleared when the pack-voltage word at state +0x118 is above 0x1503. Only 0 or 1.
